# Let the object lead {#object}

![Synthetic transparent object silhouette, generated only for layout testing.](../../../out/skill-upgrade/gallery-assets/object.png)

An object catalogue starts with the object, not a card containing its picture. The transparent silhouette in this fixture must remain transparent on the page field. The skill should contain it rather than crop its edges to imitate a photograph.

## Specifications

```metrics
Height | 78 cm | synthetic
Width | 46 cm | synthetic
Material | Timber | illustration only
```

The specifications sit beside the asset so a reader can inspect form and dimensions together. They are open rows rather than a collection of unrelated dashboard panels. This is a synthetic test object, not a product available for purchase.

## Use and care

A real catalogue would describe materials, construction, maintenance and the conditions of use. It should not attach a sustainability claim to a picture alone. Space around the silhouette is purposeful, while captions and dimensions remain legible and close to their subject.
